name: brasta-online
description: Server-authoritative online Brasta with a Vercel frontend, standalone realtime server, and Redis

scripts.sync:engine: node scripts/sync-server-engine.mjs && node scripts/patch-burn-detection.mjs && node scripts/patch-match-history.mjs
scripts.build:client: tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && tsc -p tsconfig.release-tests.json && tsc -p tsconfig.bot-tests.json
scripts.build:realtime: npm run sync:engine && npm run compile:realtime
scripts.verify:rules: node public/dist/tests-bundle.js && node public/dist/release-tests-bundle.js && node public/dist/bot-tests-bundle.js
scripts.build: npm run sync:engine && npm run build:client && npm run verify:rules && npm run verify:client-glue && npm run build:server-tests && npm run verify:online && npm run compile:realtime && next build
scripts.test:rules: npm run build:client && npm run verify:rules
scripts.test:online: npm run sync:engine && npm run build:server-tests && npm run verify:online
